notes: Choosing outfits from shops is avatar customization, which is this genre, and settlement-static is the shape whose whole point is a fixed pre-built place where personalization happens through the avatar and never through property — no plots, no claimable houses. I took Morph Roleplay over Dress Up because Dress Up builds a judging runway fed by preparation booths and nothing here is a contest; what this needs is a walkable retail strip, so I added path-street to the preset's social hub, photo spots and orientation landmark. The answers rule out walking into the shops, so building-interior is dropped and this stays a P0 build rather than the P3 this genre usually carries. With no user to ask I read the fashion mall as a bright open-air retail core rather than an enclosed single interior, and treated the catalog editor itself as UI with no geometry beyond the storefronts it is attached to.
